content.he: כֹּחַ הַתּוֹרָה לְהַעֲלוֹת חֵן. הִסְתַּכְּלוּת עַל הַשֵּׂכֶל בְּכָל דָּבָר. יַעֲקב בְּחִינַת שֵׂכֶל, עֵשָׂו בְּחִינַת בִּזּוּי שֵׂכֶל. חִבּוּר חֵית וְנוּן עוֹשֶׂה חֵן. תּוֹרָה בְּחִינַת מַקְּלוֹת חֲקוּקִים בִּשְׁמוֹת
content.en: Through Torah study, one's grace and importance are elevated before all who are needed, whether in spiritual or material matters.. A person must always contemplate the intellect present in every matter and connect to the wisdom within it.. Jacob represents the aspect of intellect (receiving the birthright), while Esau represents despising the intellect.. The letter Chet (wisdom, intellect) and Nun (kingship, malchut) combine to form Chen (grace).. The Torah is like rods engraved with divine names, through which the evil inclination is subdued.
